scenes.visual: The Re-explainer stares at a glowing screen while a tiny cursor loops back to the same paragraph.
scenes.animationCue: Screen blinks once; tired eyes drop; caption lands with a small paper-pop overshoot.

en.text: I just solved this problem. Again.

ar.text: أنا لسه حالل المشكلة دي. تاني.

scenes.visual: Three generic browser tabs split apart; chat bubbles scatter; an example token counter ticks from 1 to 2.
scenes.animationCue: Tabs wobble outward; the character re-types the same explanation; counter is stamped 'example'.

scenes.visual: The real handwritten Lake L stroke draws itself; Ripple pops out from the loop and dusts off their feet.
scenes.animationCue: L stroke uses path draw-on; Ripple squash-and-stretches on landing and raises one eyebrow.

en.text: Lake: a private gallery for your AI chats.

ar.text: Lake: معرض خاص لشاتات الـAI بتاعتك.

scenes.visual: Fictional demo library: welcome wall -> Start -> vague search -> matching chat snippet -> continue from here -> compact context block.
scenes.animationCue: UI stays calm and legible; cursor and click rings are added in post; Ripple points, reacts, then celebrates.

en.text: Press Start. Search how you remember it.
There it is. The chat you meant.
A compact context block. Ready to paste.

ar.text: دوس Start. دوّر بالكلام اللي فاكره.

scenes.visual: A laptop gets a hand-drawn lock; a dashed boundary surrounds it; a cloud icon is crossed out.
scenes.animationCue: Boundary draws around the laptop; cloud crosses itself out with one clean marker stroke.

en.text: No accounts. No cloud. Nothing leaves your laptop.

ar.text: مفيش حسابات. مفيش كلاود. مفيش حاجة بتطلع من اللابتوب.

scenes.visual: Ripple sheepishly holds a tiny local-model brain beside the untouched original transcript.
scenes.animationCue: Brain wiggles; Ripple shrugs; transcript stays solid and readable.

en.text: Still in testing. Summaries can be wrong. The original chat stays.

ar.text: لسه بنجرّب. الملخّص ممكن يِغلط. الشات الأصلي موجود دايمًا.

scenes.visual: Ripple and The Re-explainer wave beside a hand-lettered Lake lockup and two empty CTA fields.
scenes.animationCue: Both wave on alternating beats; CTA underline draws in last; placeholders remain visibly unfilled.
